Thomas Cotzand is a leading chief physician and a member of the [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] (Steering Committee) for the Acute Surgery Database [^src1]. He serves as the representative for the Danish Surgical Society (Dansk Kirurgisk Selskab) and Kolding Hospital (Kolding Sygehus) within the Region of Southern Denmark (Region Syddanmark) [^src1]. In his role on the steering committee, Cotzand is responsible for ensuring the implementation of the database's clinical standards and quality indicators across the southern Danish region [^src1]. 

His work fits into the broader narrative of the 2025 annual report for the Acute Surgery Database, which highlights the organizational governance provided by the steering committee and the ongoing regional efforts to address systemic barriers in acute surgery quality measurement, such as patient registration challenges and the early identification of high-risk patients [^src1].
